name: Wanted Board
subtitle: Everybody draws at once
description: A frontier town built as a wagon wheel — the Bank at the centre, eight more places around it, four fast spokes and a long way round the rim. Each round everybody secretly picks a card — ride, gallop two places at once, lay low, wait in ambush, rig a trap, scout for the richest target in town, or cash in — and all of them turn over at the same moment. Your bounty climbs while you run, but it is only yours once you have banked it, and the Bank is the one building everyone knows you have to walk into. Nobody waits for a turn. Play against bots, pass a phone around, or take up to five friends online.
controls: Tap a card, tap where it points, then lock it in. Everything reveals together.
